steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: OCR J280 uses specific command words that determine the depth and type of response required | Key Fact: 'Describe' means give an account of what happened or what something was like | Key Fact: 'Explain' requires giving reasons or causes — show how and why something happened | Key Fact: 'Explain the significance' demands you show both what happened and why it mattered
